BUSINESS STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   B. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   B. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   C. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   C. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   B. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

9. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

15. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
